title: Monthly Withholding Proposed on a Reduced-Withholding Request, Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
The monthly withholding proposed on a reduced-withholding request for a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is the debt's outstanding balance spread over the longest plan approved with a Financial Status Report, at the standard rate of 100 percent, rounded up to the cent, and never below the smallest reduced withholding of the debt type.

## Assembly

| Stage | Definition |
|---|---|
| Starting figure | The outstanding balance on the debt record divided by the longest plan approved with a Financial Status Report for the debt type, in months |
| Rate | The starting figure multiplied by 100 percent |
| Rounding | Rounded up to the cent once, after the rate |
| Floor | Raised to the smallest reduced withholding of the debt type if lower |

Both the longest plan with a report and the smallest reduced withholding are the debt type's figures in the schedule of repayment terms.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A balance of 4,000.00 USD, a hypothetical longest plan with a report of 60 months and a hypothetical smallest reduced withholding of 25.00 USD: 4,000.00 divided by 60 is 66.6666 USD, at 100 percent the same, rounded up to 66.67 USD, above 25.00 USD. Proposed withholding: 66.67 USD.

With a balance of 1,200.00 USD on the same figures: 20.00 USD, raised to 25.00 USD.
